reason: The official Ashford Borough Council Access CON29 Data page is directly readable without login and materially changes the method from the Planning Public Register Files workflow to the council's live office-record interactive-map/CON29 inventory. It establishes that planning applications, listed buildings and conservation areas are available through the live map and that application documentation from 2003 onward is online, but the window contains no target-specific legal parcel/title geometry for PA/2024/1920. No parcel extent is inferred from planning, listed-building or conservation-area layers; spatial retrieval/join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
